mapper.select: SELECT p.storage_time FROM vm_order_package p INNER JOIN vm_order_devices d ON p.package_code = d.package_code AND p.order_code = d.order_code AND p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t t on t.device_code = d.device_code WHERE p.delete_flag = '0' AND d.delete_flag = '0' AND d.order_code = #{orderCode} AND d.device_code = #{deviceCode} AND t.channel_code = #{channelCode}

SELECT distinct t2.start_time,t2.end_time FROM vm_channel_video_plan_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_plan_time_section_t t2 ON t1.record_plan_id = t2.record_plan_id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.device_code = #{deviceCode} and t1.channel_code= #{channelCode} AND t1.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND t1.tenant_id = #{customerCode} and t2.day_of_week = #{weekDay}

SELECT t1.channel_id AS uuid, t1.device_code, t2.device_name, t1.channel_code, t1.channel_name, t1.channel_status AS `status` FROM vm_channel_info_t t1 left join vm_device_info_t t2 on t1.device_code = t2.device_code WHERE t1.delete_flag = '0' and t2.delete_flag = '0'
